scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: This is a real scenario. You must choose and act. Do not ask hypothetical questions or invent another option. B) Start through pulse:using-pulse without invoking preflight and inspect only what the selected stage needs. C) Stop until readiness artifacts exist. Choose A, B, or C and state the concrete action you will take.
